tasks.title: Build the scenario conformance harness
tasks.completed: Independent review passed; all temporal direction and evidence findings are closed.
tasks.next: Independent review passed; all temporal direction and evidence findings are closed.
tasks.finding: Initial review found a blocker: the harness required after > before for all temporal primitives and only timestamp_delay emitted samples, causing false-negative certification for four primitives.
tasks.change: Added before/after evidence to stale_timestamp, timeout_violation, timestamp_out_of_order, and future_timestamp. Added primitive-specific forward/backward rules and a separate malformed-calendar-date rule for future_timestamp.
tasks.evidence: Claude independently reviewed the implementation and ran the full suite: 386 passed, 13 skipped, 2 deprecation warnings, exit code 0; scenario conformance tests 7/7 passed.
